description: One-time move of schema.js, handlers/, and lib/ from the project root into tgcloud/ (tgcloud upgrade). Required before other commands on projects created before CLI 0.2.0. Keeps the bot link; nothing needs to be redeployed. dry_run defaults to true and only prints the planned moves. Applying (dry_run: false) requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required confirm: true when dry_run is false

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

name: upgrade
title: Upgrade a pre-0.2.0 project layout
